description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with pure virtual methods for handling container events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling container-related events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, receives JSON data related to the event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, receives JSON data related to the event.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, receives JSON data related to the failure.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container changes state, receives JSON data about the new state.
